title: Add discriminated game-export types for llmEvents
description: The current `schemas/game_export_types.py` models `LlmEvent` as one flat `TypedDict` with many optional keys. After checking `event["type"] == "tool_call"` or `"llm_error"`, code still has to use `.get("tool")`, `.get("result")`, `.get("errorType")`, etc. because the type system cannot express which fields become mandatory for each event kind. Split `LlmEvent` into discriminated variants (`ToolCallEvent`, `LlmResponseEvent`, `LlmErrorEvent`, etc.) keyed by `type`, then update helpers in leaderboard/analysis/export code to use direct indexing where the variant guarantees the field.
